source_semantics: prescription/order records, not validated administration events
class_identification: statin medications identified via drug name mapping such as atorvastatin, simvastatin, rosuvastatin, pravastatin, lovastatin, fluvastatin, pitavastatin
window_logic: recent pre-admission window approximately bounded by prior discharge to admission anchor; project docs state this is a prescription-based historical indicator rather than verified outpatient baseline use
exposure_definition: binary admission-level indicator for recent statin prescription before admission anchor
reason: no validated treatment time zero; no guaranteed pre-treatment ECG ordering; exposure is a prescription-window summary, not exact treatment initiation
